name: monthly-report (example)
description: Illustrates a scheduled trigger that asks the app to generate a monthly report and emails it. All report generation logic (generateMonthlyReport, renderMonthlyReportHtml) stays in packages/reports — this workflow only schedules the call and delivers the result.

nodes.name: HTTP: generate report
nodes.notes: Calls an internal API route in apps/web that runs generateMonthlyReport + renderMonthlyReportHtml for each active location.
